reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small business owner without hype or sales CTAs. Minor voice inconsistency using first-person singular ('I') instead of the prescribed public voice 'we'.
reasons.clarity: Logical structure, direct explanations, and transparent qualifications on where automation fits versus manual work or human oversight.
reasons.actionability: Provides two concrete diagnostic questions and an immediate self-check rule to identify automatable workflows while reinforcing human approval boundaries.
reasons.factual_grounding: Faithfully reflects Bareni's diagnostic approach and boundaries without inventing customer results, metrics, or capabilities.
